<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/history/device-point-values/query"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Query device point value change history by device, trait, and half-open time interval `[startTime, endTime)`. The request body should directly use the data object, without type, version, or msgId.   
If `deviceIds` is empty, all currently available devices accessible in the current request context are queried; when device IDs are explicitly provided, local HTTP can query the history of deleted devices. Device IDs without permission will be skipped; if all are skipped, an empty list is returned successfully.   
If `traitCodes` is empty, there is no trait restriction; if non-empty, codes that cannot be recognized are ignored. If all cannot be recognized as a trait, a parameter error is returned.   
`cursor` is the `nextCursor` returned by the previous page; to continue pagination, the values of `deviceIds`, `traitCodes`, `startTime`, `endTime`, and `descending` must remain unchanged.   
`startTime` and `endTime` are optional: when both are omitted, the latest seven days are queried; when one is omitted, the other endpoint is derived with a seven-day window. For `cursor` pagination, the values that must remain unchanged are the server-resolved `data.startTime` and `data.endTime` returned by the first response; send them as the next request's `startTime` and `endTime`.
